QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_5

question.text: Which body has been named as the Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) for Social Impact Assessors under SEBI's SSE framework?

answer.text: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
Institute of Social Auditors of India, a not-for-profit Section 8 company under the aegis of ICAI
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.59, the SRO is the Institute of Social Auditors of India, a not-for-profit Section 8 company set up under the aegis of ICAI. ICAI is the parent body under whose aegis the SRO sits, but the SRO itself is the Institute of Social Auditors of India. The Trap: ICMAI (option A) and ICSI (option C) are unrelated to the SSE SRO mandate. NISM (option D) is the certifying body for the SIA examination, not the SRO. The named SRO is the Institute of Social Auditors of India. Note: The phrasing 'under the aegis of ICAI' captures the relationship — ICAI is the parent, the Institute of Social Auditors of India is the notified SRO.
